verdict: Ads are running and converting; lead tracking is broken and being fixed.
narrative: In the last 28 days, Google Ads delivered 80 conversions from 333 clicks on $184.70 in spend — your campaigns are generating activity. However, zero leads are registering in the system, and this is a tracking break, not a demand problem; the connection between your forms and CRM is being repaired now. Separately, your Google Business Profile engagement fell 54% week-over-week, with both locations going dark on November 1st and 2nd — this is a real drop in organic visibility that could be affecting call and walk-in volume on its own. We're actively investigating the profile suppression to restore local reach. Once lead tracking is repaired, you'll have a clear picture of what this period's ad spend actually produced in the pipeline.
